rule: Every mandatory journey must be PASS. NOT_RUN, FAILED or BLOCKED keeps release at NO-GO.

journeys.title: Cold start
journeys.check: Launch app; valid RMW screen appears; no crash or unrecoverable error.

journeys.title: Background and resume
journeys.check: Background app for 5 seconds and resume; state remains coherent.

journeys.title: Process restart
journeys.check: Close app completely and relaunch; app starts without corrupt-state or migration error.

journeys.title: Primary navigation
journeys.check: Open each visible primary navigation action; no crash and navigation is reversible.

journeys.title: Offline cold start
journeys.check: Launch without network; app remains usable or explains recoverable offline state.

journeys.title: Create local profile
journeys.check: Create a local profile and confirm it is available after navigation away and back.

journeys.title: Profile persistence
journeys.check: Restart app after profile creation; same local profile is restored.

journeys.title: Start journey
journeys.check: Start a journey; JourneyInstance is created and first stage/scene becomes visible.

journeys.title: Journey checkpoint
journeys.check: Progress to a checkpoint; leave and resume; correct checkpoint is restored.

journeys.title: Dialogue scene
journeys.check: Open dialogue content; target-language text renders correctly and scene can advance.

journeys.title: Choice scene
journeys.check: Choose an available answer; only the selected transition is applied.

journeys.title: Text input scene
journeys.check: Enter text and submit; input is accepted/rejected deterministically without crash.

journeys.title: Listening scene
journeys.check: Play learning audio; playback state is visible and repeated play does not duplicate or crash.

journeys.title: Audio stop and replay
journeys.check: Stop audio and replay; controller returns to a consistent state.

journeys.title: Content validation failure
journeys.check: Invalid/missing content produces controlled recovery behavior rather than a crash.

journeys.title: Story event projection
journeys.check: Complete an interaction that emits a story event; projection reflects it once.

journeys.title: Story projection rebuild
journeys.check: Rebuild projection from stored events; resulting state matches pre-rebuild state.

journeys.title: Evidence creation
journeys.check: Complete evidence-generating interaction; evidence event is persisted once.

journeys.title: Atomic interaction commit
journeys.check: Commit interaction; journey/story/evidence changes are all visible together and not partially applied.

journeys.title: Duplicate commit protection
journeys.check: Repeat same interaction commit identifier; state is not duplicated.

journeys.title: Language book projection
journeys.check: Earn a language-book item; personal language book shows the projected entry.

journeys.title: Passport projection
journeys.check: Complete qualifying evidence; language passport reflects the expected progress entry.

journeys.title: Microphone permission and speech capture
journeys.check: On a real device request microphone permission, record a speech attempt and receive a controlled result.

journeys.title: Speech denied fallback
journeys.check: Deny microphone permission; app offers speech-free route/help and remains usable.

journeys.title: Speech unavailable fallback
journeys.check: Simulate unavailable recognizer; app selects deterministic speech-free route.

journeys.title: Greek semantic evaluation
journeys.check: Evaluate controlled Greek input; accepted/rejected outcome matches configured semantic rules.

journeys.title: Speech attempt commit
journeys.check: Successful speech evaluation commits progress/evidence exactly once.

journeys.title: Real Greek speech recognition
journeys.check: On a real device speak the prescribed Greek phrases; recognition/evaluation completes and results are recorded.

journeys.title: Network loss during journey
journeys.check: Lose network while in a journey; local state remains coherent and user can continue where designed.

journeys.title: Network restoration
journeys.check: Restore network after offline state; app recovers without duplicate progress or restart requirement.

journeys.title: Artifact snapshot
journeys.check: Create an artifact snapshot; snapshot contains stable claims and can be read again.

journeys.title: Help sheet access
journeys.check: Open contextual help from supported interaction; help is readable and dismissible without losing progress.

journeys.title: Android lifecycle real device
journeys.check: On Android: launch, background, resume, force-close and relaunch; no data loss or crash.

journeys.title: iOS lifecycle real device
journeys.check: On iPhone: launch, background, resume, terminate and relaunch; no data loss or crash.

journeys.title: TalkBack navigation
journeys.check: On Android with TalkBack, traverse primary screens and activate primary actions with understandable labels/order.

journeys.title: VoiceOver navigation
journeys.check: On iPhone with VoiceOver, traverse primary screens and activate primary actions with understandable labels/order.

journeys.title: Real device network switching
journeys.check: During use switch Wi-Fi/mobile data/offline and back; app remains coherent and recovers without duplicate state.

journeys.title: Reduced motion policy
journeys.check: Enable reduced-motion preference; nonessential motion is reduced while interactions remain understandable.

journeys.title: Large text resilience
journeys.check: Use enlarged system text; primary content/actions remain readable and reachable without critical clipping.

journeys.title: Migration from empty database
journeys.check: Fresh database applies all migrations and app boots normally.

journeys.title: Migration with existing local state
journeys.check: Upgrade representative existing database; profile/journey/story data remains readable.

journeys.title: Character knowledge persistence
journeys.check: Create a character fact; restart/reload and verify the fact remains projected once.

journeys.title: Error recovery screen
journeys.check: Trigger controlled bootstrap/content error; recovery UI appears and retry/back path works.

journeys.title: No duplicate evidence after retry
journeys.check: Retry an interrupted interaction; evidence/story/progress are not duplicated.

journeys.title: End-to-end beginner lesson
journeys.check: From app start complete one representative beginner lesson through content, interaction, evidence and personal-system projection.

journeys.title: End-to-end resume and completion
journeys.check: Start a representative lesson, leave app, resume, finish and confirm final progress is persisted once.
